concepts.label: Infant head support
concepts.definition: Permission and methods for discreetly supporting an infant's head in an application photograph.
concepts.quote: The infant's head may be discreetly supported, e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child.

concepts.definition: Advisory caution noting that certificate photographs may not have been taken within six months due to agency processing times, regardless of recent certificate issuance.
concepts.quote: Be aware that even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application.
